summary: 18 July 2026 ko victim ne refund ke liye online customer care ka number dhoondha. Thodi der baad unke account se paise nikal gaye. Tumhare paas victim ke us din ke WhatsApp messages (saari chats ek file mein, time ke order mein), call log, aur victim ke phone ki ek photo hai. Sab kuch synthetic hai.

questions.text: Victim ko screen-sharing app install karne ko kisne kaha?
Victim ne phone ka control kab saunpa (screen ka code kab bataya)?
Phone wali photo li gayi tab victim kahan tha?
